sourceLimitation: The object identifiers and displayed coordinates were discovered through an OSM-derived index. Raw OpenStreetMap node/way geometry has not yet been persisted, so none of these candidates can verify a canonical coordinate in this probe.

candidates.name: Oscarsborg Fortress
candidates.rejectionReason: Generic POI near the southern batteries; not documented as the visitor-core or main-fort anchor.

candidates.name: Oscarsborg festning
candidates.rejectionReason: A point object does not resolve whether it represents Hovedfortet, the southern battery cluster or the full fortress system.

candidates.name: Hovedbatteriet
candidates.nextAction: Persist raw way geometry and derive a deterministic building or interior point.

candidates.name: Torpedobatteriet sight-tower cluster
candidates.nextAction: Resolve the torpedo-battery building or protected-object geometry rather than using sight towers as a proxy.

candidates.name: Kopåsbatteriet
candidates.representationNote: Too far from the island core for the current 360 m radius; should remain a secondary contextual anchor or become a separate canonical place.

decision.blockedReason: No raw central-fort polygon, official representation point or complete multi-anchor geometry has been captured.
decision.nextAction: Persist raw geometry for Hovedfortet/Hovedbatteriet and the Torpedobatteriet, then choose a visitor-core area anchor and explicit secondary anchors. Do not promote either generic OSM point or a photo geotag.
